notes: «فيما قرئ عليه» is a reading formula, not a name, and is left out.
«عبد الله بن، أبي بكر» keeps the comma the text writes inside the name; «عن أبيه» is a bare relation link (rule 7).
«وذكر، لها أن عبد الله بن عمر، يقول» places Ibn Umar's claim inside the story that Aisha answers; the saying relayed is Aisha's, so he is not a link and عائشة is the last link (rule 6).

fixes.reason: RWY reads the verb «أخبرته» as a transmitter name; in the text it is the verb of Amra's report, not a person.
RWY adds Ibn Umar as the last link; the text places his claim in the scene that Aisha corrects, and the saying relayed is hers.

evidence.quote: وذكر، لها أن عبد الله بن عمر، يقول
